item.title: Medtronic Xomed, Inc.: BOBBIN VENTILATION TUBE 5PK 1.14 FLPL, REF: 1010201, Lot# 0231048277 (GTIN 20763000281612). Recall
item.product: BOBBIN VENTILATION TUBE 5PK 1.14 FLPL, REF: 1010201, Lot# 0231048277 (GTIN 20763000281612).
item.summary: Ventilation tubes, that provide a passageway for movement of air between the auditory canal and the middle ear, were not subjected to the required sterilization process, which after implantation could cause infection and subsequent inflammation potentially leading to temporary hearing impairment, otorrhea (fluid discharge) and the need for antibiotics. Product details: BOBBIN VENTILATION TUBE 5PK 1.14 FLPL, REF: 1010201, Lot# 0231048277 (GTIN 20763000281612).
